EU-Indonesia trade deal opens new export and investment opportunities

The EU-Indonesia trade agreement offers new export and investment opportunities for Jakarta and Brussels. Challenges remain over whether Indonesia can turn Europe's growing interest in its markets and critical minerals into sustainable gains at home.

Reported by DW.
